title: 技能：翻译技能里「规范说明写 {variable}、与运行时不一致」的旁注已过时（#38090 后两边一致），删改它
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① (b) review nit N1 on PR #38090 (#37894), left by its author and both review rounds to a seat follow-up card (records 7232513584 and 7233057981). Source: fleet.
Grading: area:ai · Docs · p3 · reach: agents reading the i18n skill's interpolation section · evidence: `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` at origin/main 7605e0c9.
Dedupe: "schema docstring mentions {variable}", "objectstack-i18n interpolation aside" → only #37894 (the fix that made the aside stale).

## 维护者速读

- 问题：翻译技能里有一句旁注，说规范的说明文字写的是 `{variable}`、跟运行时不一致。#38090 合入后两边已经一致（都是双花括号），这句旁注说的分歧不存在了。
- 修法：删掉或改写这句旁注；技能本身「用双花括号」的建议不变。
- 要你做的：无。

## Ask

`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` l.272–274 (Message Interpolation → Simple Format) ends with: "(The schema docstring mentions `{variable}` notation, but that is not what the runtime implements.)". Since PR #38090 (merge 86ce7a33), the schema's own sentence (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`, the `messageFormat` retired-key guidance) says interpolation in a message read through `t()` is double-brace `{{variable}}` substitution, a single brace is left as written, and activity-milestone summaries keep their own `{field}` tokens.

Replace the aside with a sentence true at HEAD, for example that the schema states the same rule and that activity-milestone summaries (`objects.OBJECT._milestones.FIELD.VALUE.summary`) are the one slot that fills single-brace `{field}` tokens. Keep the double-brace advice.

## Done when

- The aside no longer claims a docstring/runtime disagreement.
- If the milestone exception is named, it matches `translation.zod.ts` and `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`.
- Whatever skills generator or check covers `skills/**` stays green.
